preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and inspection count k are within the stated bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each a_i (time spent on node i) is a positive integer within the stated bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n-1 edges, each connecting two distinct nodes within the valid range.
The edges form a connected, undirected tree with n nodes (no cycles, all nodes reachable).

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the maximum grade Jacob can achieve by optimally choosing the root and ordering neighbors.

postconditions.expression: max_grade == max(min(a_i for a_i in dfs_order[:k]) for dfs_order in possible_dfs_orders(edges, a))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible minimum a_i among the first k nodes in any DFS traversal order, where the traversal is determined by an optimal root and neighbor ordering.
